tasksmd.reindex.title: 모든 태스크 다시 인덱싱 (Reindex all tasks)
tasksmd.config.taskFormat: Format used when writing task fields. Both formats are always read.
tasksmd.config.globalFilter: If set (e.g. #task), only checklist lines containing this text are treated as tasks.
tasksmd.config.removeGlobalFilterFromDes: Hide the global filter text when displaying task descriptions. The file is never changed.
tasksmd.config.include: Glob patterns of files to scan for tasks.
tasksmd.config.exclude: Glob patterns to exclude from scanning (files.exclude is also respected).
tasksmd.config.maxFileSizeKB: Files larger than this (KB) are skipped and reported in the status bar.
tasksmd.config.setCreatedDate: Add a created date (➕) when creating tasks through the extension.
tasksmd.config.setDoneDate: Add a done date (✅) when a task becomes DONE, and remove it when it leaves DONE.
tasksmd.config.setCancelledDate: Add a cancelled date (❌) when a task becomes CANCELLED, and remove it when it leaves CANCELLED.
tasksmd.showLogs.title: 로그 보기 (Show logs)
tasksmd.toggleDone.title: 태스크 완료 토글 (Toggle task done)
tasksmd.openTask.title: 태스크로 이동 (Go to task)

tasksmd.markCancelled.title: 취소로 표시 (Mark as cancelled)
tasksmd.reopen.title: 태스크 다시 열기 (Reopen task)

tasksmd.tree.clearFilter.title: 필터 지우기 (Clear filter)
tasksmd.config.decorations.relativeDates: Show relative dates (e.g. '3 days left', '2 days overdue') at the end of task lines.
tasksmd.config.decorations.overdueHighli: Highlight the background of overdue and due-today task lines.
tasksmd.config.decorations.strikeDone: Strike through and dim completed (done/cancelled) tasks.
tasksmd.config.decorations.dimFields: Render task metadata (dates, priority, id…) in a muted colour so the description stands out.
tasksmd.config.decorations.gutterIcons: Show a status icon in the gutter of every task line.
tasksmd.color.dueTodayBackground: Background of task lines due today.
tasksmd.color.fieldForeground: Colour of task metadata (dates, priority, id…).
tasksmd.color.hintForeground: Colour of the relative-date hint after task lines.
tasksmd.createOrEdit.title: 태스크 만들기 / 편집 (Create or edit task)
tasksmd.setStatus.title: 상태 설정… (Set status…)
tasksmd.setPriority.title: 우선순위 설정… (Set priority…)
tasksmd.setDueDate.title: 마감일 설정… (Set due date…)
tasksmd.setScheduledDate.title: 예정일 설정… (Set scheduled date…)
tasksmd.setStartDate.title: 시작일 설정… (Set start date…)
tasksmd.postpone.title: 미루기… (Postpone…)
tasksmd.config.codeLens.mode: Where to show task action CodeLenses (Done · Priority · Due · Edit).
tasksmd.config.codeLens.mode.cursorLine: Only above the task line that has the cursor
tasksmd.config.autoSuggest.enabled: Offer task field suggestions (due, priority, every week, id…) while typing on a task line.
tasksmd.config.autoSuggest.minMatch: Minimum typed characters before keyword suggestions appear automatically (0 = right after a space). Ctrl+Space always shows them.
tasksmd.config.autoSuggest.maxItems: Maximum number of keyword suggestions shown.
tasksmd.config.recurrence.insertPosition: Where the next instance of a completed recurring task is inserted.
tasksmd.config.recurrence.idHandling: What happens to the 🆔 of a recurring task on its next instance.
tasksmd.config.recurrence.idHandling.kee: Keep the same id (dependencies keep pointing at the recurring task)
tasksmd.config.recurrence.copyDependsOn: Copy ⛔ dependencies to the next instance of a recurring task.
tasksmd.config.recurrence.removeSchedule: Drop the ⏳ scheduled date on the next instance when the task also has a start or due date.
tasksmd.config.statuses: Checkbox statuses: the character between `[` and `]`, its name, the symbol it toggles to, and its type (TODO, IN_PROGRESS, ON_HOLD, DONE, CANCELLED, NON_TASK). Behaviour (done dates, recurrence) follows the type. Use `Tasks: Load status preset…` to import a theme's set.
tasksmd.config.statuses.name: Display name.
tasksmd.config.statuses.nextSymbol: Symbol the task moves to when toggled.
tasksmd.loadStatusPreset.title: 상태 프리셋 불러오기… (Load status preset…)
tasksmd.changeStatusTo.title: 상태 변경… (Change status to…)
tasksmd.setDependencies.title: 의존성 설정… (Set dependencies…)
tasksmd.setRecurrence.title: 반복 설정… (Set recurrence…)
tasksmd.config.query.allowFunctions: Allow `filter by function`, `sort by function` and `group by function` in queries. These run JavaScript from your notes, so they are off by default and never run in untrusted workspaces.
tasksmd.capabilities.untrusted: Custom JavaScript query functions, OS notifications and update checks are disabled in untrusted workspaces.
tasksmd.capabilities.virtual: Task indexing needs a file system; virtual workspaces are read-only.
tasksmd.config.savedQueries: Saved queries shown in the sidebar (also picked up from `.tasks/queries/*.md` files in the workspace).
tasksmd.config.savedQueries.query: Query text, one instruction per line (use \n).

tasksmd.config.preview.enabled: Render tasks (checkboxes, badges) and ```tasks query blocks in the Markdown preview.
tasksmd.config.preview.renderBadges: Show task metadata as badges in the preview instead of the raw emoji/Dataview text.
tasksmd.config.editModal.accessKeys: Enable Alt+letter access keys for the fields of the Create or edit task dialog.
tasksmd.config.editModal.hiddenFields: Fields to hide in the Create or edit task dialog.
tasksmd.openKanban.title: 칸반 보드 열기 (Open kanban board)
tasksmd.openQueryBuilder.title: 쿼리 빌더 열기 (Open query builder)
tasksmd.savedQuery.openInBuilder.title: 쿼리 빌더에서 열기 (Open in query builder)
tasksmd.config.notifications.enabled: Show a daily summary (due today / overdue) and a digest of tasks due soon.
tasksmd.config.notifications.os: Also send native OS notifications (macOS Notification Center, Windows toast, Linux notify-send). Trusted workspaces only.
tasksmd.config.notifications.dailyTime: Time of day (HH:MM) for the daily summary; also shown on startup if not yet shown today.
tasksmd.config.notifications.dueWithinDa: Include tasks due within this many days in the digest (0 = only today).
tasksmd.config.archive.file: Workspace-relative file that archived tasks are appended to.
tasksmd.config.archive.afterDays: Archive completed (done/cancelled) tasks whose completion date is at least this many days old. 0 archives every completed task, including undated ones.
tasksmd.config.archive.linkStyle: How the archive links back to the source file: [[wiki]] links or [markdown](links).
tasksmd.archiveCompleted.title: 완료 태스크 아카이브… (Archive completed tasks…)
tasksmd.openStats.title: 통계 열기 (Open statistics)
tasksmd.config.calendar.newTaskFile: Workspace-relative Markdown file that receives tasks created from the calendar (and other views without a target). Empty = the active Markdown editor.
tasksmd.openCalendar.title: 캘린더 열기 (Open calendar)
tasksmd.openRendered.title: 렌더 보기로 열기 (Open rendered view)
tasksmd.openRenderedToSide.title: 렌더 보기를 옆에 열기 (Open rendered view to the side)
tasksmd.openSource.title: 마크다운 소스 편집 (Edit Markdown source)
tasksmd.openCalendarFullScreen.title: 캘린더 열기(전체 화면) (Open calendar (full screen))
tasksmd.toggleFullScreen.title: 캘린더: 전체 화면 전환 (Calendar: toggle full screen)
tasksmd.config.rendered.fieldStyle: How task fields (dates, priority, recurrence…) are shown on task lines in the rendered view.
tasksmd.config.rendered.fieldStyle.plain: As in the source line: emoji + value, no chips (relative date in the tooltip).
tasksmd.config.rendered.fieldStyle.badge: Pill badges with relative dates, like the Markdown preview.
tasksmd.config.rendered.fontSize: Body font size (px) of the rendered view.
tasksmd.config.rendered.lineHeight: Line height of the rendered view body (multiplier).
tasksmd.config.api.writePolicy: What happens when another extension writes tasks through the Tasks API.
tasksmd.config.api.writePolicy.confirm: Ask once per extension and remember the answer in tasksmd.api.allowedWriters.
tasksmd.config.api.writePolicy.deny: Refuse all API writes (reads still work).
tasksmd.config.api.allowedWriters: Extension ids allowed to write through the API without asking (filled in by the confirmation dialog).
tasksmd.config.api.batchLimit: Maximum number of operations in one tasksmd API batch call.
tasksmd.config.rendered.fieldsAlign: Where task fields (dates, priority, …) sit on a task line in the rendered view.
tasksmd.config.rendered.fieldsAlign.righ: Description on the left, fields pushed to the right edge of the column.
tasksmd.config.rendered.fieldsAlign.inli: Fields directly after the description, like the source line.
tasksmd.config.requireDueDate: Require a due date: the create dialog, the API, the CLI and the MCP server refuse a new task without 📅, and the editor warns on open tasks that have none.
tasksmd.config.calendar.fontSize: Font size (px) of the tasks shown in calendar cells.
tasksmd.config.calendar.fullScreen: What the calendar's Full screen button does.
tasksmd.config.calendar.fullScreen.maxim: Hide the side bars and the bottom panel and maximize the calendar's editor group.
tasksmd.config.calendar.fullScreen.windo: Additionally switch the whole window to full screen.
tasksmd.config.updateCheckUrl: For .vsix installs: path or URL of a latest.json ({ version, vsix, notes }). Checked once a day; empty disables the check. Ignored for marketplace installs.
tasksmd.checkForUpdates.title: 업데이트 확인 (.vsix) (Check for updates (.vsix))
tasksmd.convertFormat.title: 이 파일의 태스크 포맷 변환… (Convert task format in this file…)
tasksmd.config.language: Language of the extension's UI (sidebar, dialogs, hints). Command titles and setting descriptions always follow the editor's display language. Reload the window after changing.
